\caption{SIMCF step-by-step ablation on Cityscapes train. All variants share
the DCFA-conditioned k{=}80 semantic source and DepthPro $\tau{=}0.20$ instance
proposals; only the SIMCF stages applied differ. SIMCF-A (intra-instance
majority vote) repairs class leakage inside instance regions; SIMCF-B
(cosine-merge of adjacent same-class fragments at $\tau_\text{sim}{=}0.85$)
contributes nearly all of the PQ$^{th}$ gain by reversing depth-induced
over-fragmentation; SIMCF-C (depth-implausibility void at $\eta{=}3.0\sigma$)
trades a small ignore rate for cleaner stuff supervision.}
